description: Hand-labelled posts for the sentiment benchmark. Mostly real headlines/posts collected by EchoFlow in October 2026 (searches: Finland, football, AI), plus a few written to cover Finnish and clear-cut cases. 'accept' lists every label we consider correct; ambiguous posts accept more than one.

labels.pos: good news or a happy/approving tone
labels.neu: factual, informational, a question, mixed or unclear
labels.neg: bad news or an unhappy/critical tone
